title: Synthetic Autism Intervention Planning Dataset (500 Children)
subtitle: AI-Driven Personalized Intervention Guidelines, SMART Goals, Therapy Notes & Milestones for ASD
description: A comprehensive synthetic dataset of 500 children with Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) for developing AI-driven personalized intervention planning systems. Includes child profiles with ADOS-2/cognitive/adaptive assessment scores, evidence-based intervention guidelines, SMART developmental goals, 9,400+ therapy session notes, milestones, plain-language caregiver guidance, progress summaries, and governance audit logs. Designed by studying real clinical document types (autism assessments, speech-language reports, feeding evaluations, school reports, IEPs). 22,000+ total records across 9 interconnected tables. Created for the paper: AI-Driven Personalized Intervention Guideline Generator for Children with Autism Based on Screening Outcomes.

resources.description: 500 synthetic child profiles with demographics, ASD support levels, assessment scores, strengths/gaps, and family priorities
Standardized autism screening assessment results including ADOS-2, cognitive, and adaptive behavior scores
1,311 personalized evidence-based intervention recommendations across developmental domains
1,347 SMART developmental goals with baselines, targets, measurement methods, and timelines
9,398 individual therapy session records with mood, engagement, interventions, behaviors, success rates, and narratives
1,347 short-term and long-term developmental milestone plans aligned with SMART goals
500 plain-language home activity recommendation packages for parents and caregivers
1,347 per-goal progress analyses with trend detection (Improving, Slow Progress, Plateau, Regression)
6,000 governance and AI agent execution audit records with confidence scores and escalation flags
